Description: Combine fast active duration (duration-75) with a snappy spring-like release curve so clicks feel crisp on press and elastic on release.
Do: Use active:scale-[0.97] active:translate-y-[1px] active:duration-75 transition-transform duration-150 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)]
Don't: Use transition-all duration-300 active:scale-95 (animates press-in way too slowly and causes layout/color lag)
Code Good: class="transition-transform duration-150 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)] active:scale-[0.97] active:translate-y-[1px] active:duration-75 motion-reduce:transform-none"

Guideline: Expand Compact Hitboxes with after:absolute after:-inset-2
Description: Use Tailwind's after: pseudo-element utilities to give 16x16px or 20x20px icon buttons a forgiving 36x36px+ touch/click zone.
Do: Add relative after:absolute after:-inset-2 after:content-[''] to compact icon controls
Don't: Leave tiny close or action icons with raw 16px hit targets
Code Good: <button class="relative p-1 after:absolute after:-inset-2 after:content-['']" aria-label="Close">

Guideline: Enforce tabular-nums on Dynamic Counters and Badges
Description: Prevent horizontal layout jitter during number rolls, countdowns, and live metric updates.
Do: Add the tabular-nums utility class to every price, counter, badge, and table metric
Don't: Animate numbers in proportional sans-serif without tabular-nums

Guideline: 3D Depressible Keycap Buttons with Border-Bottom Collapse
Description: Create tactile physical buttons or <kbd> badges by pairing a bottom border with active translate-y depression.
Do: Match the active:translate-y-[2px] distance to the border-b-2 reduction
Don't: Translate downward without reducing the bottom shadow/border (shifts the whole layout height)
Code Good: class="border border-b-[3px] border-zinc-700 active:border-b active:translate-y-[2px] transition-all duration-75"
